title: Quick questions before I design this
lede: A consulting website that helps international athletes, their parents and coaches understand US college scholarships and tennis academies, then book a session (in person or virtual) with an expert after filling in a short intake form.

questions.title: Which page should I design first?
questions.why: Every design will show the same page, so you can compare styles side by side. The home page sets the tone for everything else.

options.label: Home page
options.detail: Explains the two paths (college scholarship or pro academy) and leads to booking

options.label: Book a session + intake form
options.detail: Pick a time, choose virtual or in person, answer questions about the athlete

options.label: College scholarships guide
options.detail: How US scholarships work and how to get the biggest share

questions.ownPlaceholder: e.g. a page comparing tennis academies

questions.title: What should it feel like when a parent or athlete lands on it?
questions.why: Families are making a big money decision, often in a second language. The feel decides the colors, type and how much is on each screen.
questions.textPlaceholder: e.g. Like a trusted advisor who has been through it, not a sales pitch

questions.title: What should it definitely NOT look like?
questions.why: Ruling things out is the fastest way to keep the designs from looking like every other sports site.

options.label: Stock photos of trophies and handshakes

questions.title: Should the pages show real photos?
questions.why: Photos of athletes, courts and campuses change the whole layout, so I want to know before I start.

options.label: Yes, athlete and campus photos
options.detail: I will use placeholder photos you can swap later

options.label: A photo of the expert
options.detail: Put a face to the consultant

questions.title: How many designs should I make?
questions.why: More designs give more range; fewer are quicker to compare.

questions.title: Anything already decided?
questions.why: Optional. A business name, a logo, a color you must use, the languages the site needs, or a website you like the look of.
questions.placeholder: e.g. The business is called ..., it needs English and Spanish

avoid: Stock photos of trophies and handshakes
